kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-45
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '45'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-45
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-45
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-734
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '734'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-734
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-734
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-930
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '930'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-930
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-930
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-1577
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '1577'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-1577
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-1577
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-1674
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '1674'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-1674
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-1674
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-2451
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '2451'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-2451
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-2451
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-3485
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '3485'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-3485
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-3485
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-3905
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '3905'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-3905
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-3905
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

        ports:

          runAsNonRoot: true

          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-4745
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '4745'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-4745
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-4745
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

    instance: '5165'

        ports:

            memory: 128Mi

          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000

          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-5585
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '5585'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-5585
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-5585
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-6005
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '6005'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-6005
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-6005
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

        ports:

          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-6845
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '6845'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-6845
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-6845
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-7265
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '7265'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-7265
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-7265
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-7685
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '7685'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-7685
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-7685
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-8105
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '8105'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-8105
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-8105
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

  name: benchmark-app-8525

    app: benchmark
    instance: '8525'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-8525

    metadata:

        app: benchmark-8525
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:

            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}

          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000

          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000

          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-9785
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '9785'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-9785
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-9785
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-10205
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '10205'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-10205
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-10205
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-10722
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '10722'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-10722
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-10722
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-11142
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '11142'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-11142
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-11142
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

          runAsNonRoot: true

          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:

      app: benchmark-11982

            memory: 128Mi

          runAsNonRoot: true

          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-12402
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '12402'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-12402
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-12402
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

  name: benchmark-app-13242

    instance: '13242'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:

        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:

            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}

          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000

          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-13662
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '13662'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-13662
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-13662
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-14082
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '14082'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-14082
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-14082
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-14502
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '14502'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-14502
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-14502
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

  name: benchmark-app-15019
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '15019'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-15019
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-15019
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-15439
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '15439'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-15439
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-15439
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-15859
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '15859'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-15859
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-15859
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

  name: benchmark-app-16279
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '16279'
spec:
  replicas: 3

    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-16279

        app: benchmark-16279

      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:

            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}

          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000

          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-16699
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '16699'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-16699
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-16699
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-17119
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '17119'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-17119
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-17119
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-18379
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '18379'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-18379
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-18379
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-18799
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '18799'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-18799
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-18799
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-19219
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '19219'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-19219
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-19219
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-19639
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '19639'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-19639
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-19639
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: benchmark-app-20479
  labels:
    app: benchmark
    instance: '20479'
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: benchmark-20479
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: benchmark-20479
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests: {}
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
